name: Mejiro Ardan
description: From the anime "Umamusume: Cinderella Gray" comes a 1/7 scale figure of Mejiro Ardan! The dynamic figure features Mejiro Ardan wearing a gentle and elegant smile while posed with one leg lifted. The individual tufts of her flowy, long hair hair have been sculpted in layers and carefully painted to achieve a translucent look. The details of her fluttering skirt and accessories add a stunning touch to the figure, making it visually appealing from a multitude of angles. Her black, white and emerald green outfit is covered in frills, ribbons and gold decorations, which have been meticulously brought to life in figure form. Another visual highlight of the figure is the paintwork of the delicate shadows on the various parts of the outfit. Be sure to add the beautiful and determined Mejiro Ardan to your collection!

name: MODEROID Manon Guardian
description: From the anime series "Giant Gorg" comes a MODEROID plastic model of the purple giant Manon Guardian, controlled by the alien Manon! · The model stands at approx. 170mm in height and its joints are fully articulated. Interchangeable hand parts are included. · Choose between a hard plastic lower torso part and one made with more flexible material for improved articulation. · Two laser rifles are included, with energy tubes made of soft, flexible material. They can be mounted to the back of the model. · The hatches on the left and right sides of the torso can be opened. · Miniature figures (unpainted) of Manon, Tomenik, Sarah, Aroi and a pilot, that were sculpted in the same scale relative to the model, are included. · The various parts of the mecha have been separated into various colored runners and pre-painted parts, and the model kit also comes with stickers, making it easy to recreate the mecha from the series with a simple assembly.

name: PLAMATEA Arika Yumemiya
description: From the anime "My-Otome HiME" comes the first PLAMATEA plastic model of protagonist Arika Yumemiya! · The model stands at 140mm in height and is articulated. Includes various interchangeable hand parts. · The model features Arika in her Garderobe Academy uniform. A broom and bag are included as optional parts for recreating various scenes from her school life. · Includes interchangeable skirt parts for a wider range articulation. · Her distinctive hair is articulated in places thanks to included ball joints. · You can choose her eyes using included water-slide decals. Smile A and Smile B (confident smile) are included. Choose your preferred eye direction: forward, to the left or to the right. · One pre-painted Smile A face plate with forward-facing eyes and a closed mouth is included. Two unpainted face plates to which decals can be applied—one with an open mouth and one with a closed mouth—are also included. · Apron and knee socks patterns can be recreated with included decals. · The various parts of model have been separated into different colored runners and pre-painted parts, making it easy to recreate the character with a simple assembly. · Articulated stand included.

name: Rerelease [MODEROID Full Power Gridman]
description: From the movie "GRIDMAN UNIVERSE" comes a plastic model of Full Power Gridman!・Full Power Gridman has been brought into model form based on its heroic looks from the anime series.・In combined form, Full Power Gridman stands at 165mm in height (to top of head). Gridman is approximately 100mm in height.・Each combination of Gridman and the four assist weapons can be recreated with the use of interchangeable parts.・The Powered Zenon combination can be recreated. Combination parts for the thigh area are included, providing a strong sense of stability and high articulation. Special leg cover parts for creating both Full Power Gridman's heroic form and Powered Zenon's styling are included.・Translucent parts are used in various areas, including the Full Power Gridman helmet.・The various parts of the mecha have been separated into various colored runners and pre-painted parts, and the model kit also comes with stickers, making it easy to recreate the mecha from the series with a simple assembly.・The package art is illustrated by GRIDMAN UNIVERSE Heroic Animation Chief Hiroki Mutaguchi.
